**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The licence package in § 13 already sits at our preferred position on every parameter:

| Playbook element | Where satisfied |
|---|---|
| Affiliates + contractors covered | § 13.1 grants access to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users |
| Paid-up licences perpetual/irrevocable | § 13.2 — "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," including modification and derivative-work rights; reinforced by § 14.3 and preserved by § 10.1 |
| Subscription licence not revocable at will | § 13.3 — revocation/suspension only during a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity |
| Transferable to successors | § 13.3 (transfer to Affiliate or successor), supported by § 24.1 (consent-free assignment in M&A) and § 24.4 (no Vendor termination/repricing on change of control) |

The § 13.4 use restrictions are conventional, knowledge-qualified, and expressly carve out security-exhibit testing and use of Customer Data and output, so they do not erode the grant. I confirmed by search that no other provision creates a broader Vendor suspension or revocation right.
